Heard both sides.
2.This writ appeal is directed against an interim order of stay granted by the learned Single Judge.
The appellant has already filed vacate stay petition.
When the vacate stay petition has been filed, an appeal against interim order may not be maintainable.
3.Granting liberty to the appellant to work out his rights before the learned Single Judge, this writ appeal is dismissed.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
